sections.heading: Chronosphere limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No public list price — do not invent a host or GB floor; Pilot length is FAQ-typical (2–3 weeks), not a published 14-day self-serve tile because it forces process changes or add-ons around Chronosphere when incident management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Pilot with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain incident management at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Pilot · incident management | Production (contact sales).
